# IGLA TACTICAL BRIEF — Ascent Defense vs PRX (Post-Pistol, Full Buy)

---

## THREAT ASSESSMENT

PRX **will execute fast** — expect commitment before the 60-second mark. Do not wait for intel that never comes. Assume aggression.

---

## RECOMMENDED SETUP (A SITE DEFENSE)

### Positioning
| Player | Role | Position |
|--------|------|----------|
| **Killjoy** | Anchor | A Site — place Nanoswarm on **default plant only** (standard effective setup) |
| **1 Duelist** | Aggression check | A Main / Catwalk — early info, then fall back immediately |
| **1 Sentinel/Controller** | Mid control | Mid / Courtyard — cuts off A Short rotations |
| **2 remaining** | Flexible | B Site — hold honest, ready to rotate |

---

## KEY ADJUSTMENTS vs PRX SPECIFICALLY

- **Don't over-commit to A early.** PRX uses fast executes to bait rotations, then punish B. Keep your B anchor **honest.**
- **Expect a pre-60 second execute** — your A Main aggressor must gather info and **retreat before getting traded**, not duel.
- **Stack utility at chokepoints**, not site interior. Slow down their tempo with mollies/slow orbs at A Main entry — every second buys your team shape.

---

## IF THEY EXECUTE FAST AND PLANT

> Apply **Low Time Round Defense** protocol:

1. ✅ **Do NOT die for free** — bodies matter for retake
2. ✅ **Killjoy Nanoswarm activates** on default plant — delays detonation window
3. ✅ **Stall entry** with remaining utility from off-angles
4. ✅ Let the clock compress their post-plant options before committing to retake

---

## BOTTOM LINE

> **PRX wins when you react to their pace. Win by making them slow down.**
> Deny early information, waste their utility at entry, and retake on YOUR timing — not theirs.
